glosses: flow, flood, high tide (rising movement of the tide; the time around when it reaches its peak)
flood(s), great masses of water, usually of the sea
flooding, flood, overflow of a body of water; usually only when very violent and disastrous

examples.text: Viele Häuser wurden durch die Flut fortgespült.
examples.en: A lot of houses were washed away by the flood.

examples.text: Flut ist heute Nachmittag um 3 Uhr.
examples.en: High tide is at 3 p.m. today.

examples.text: Das Haus wurde von der Flut mitgerissen.
examples.en: The house was carried away by the flood.
